exposure: Laparoscopic management of ovarian cysts during pregnancy in emergency situations
outcome: Maternal complications (operation duration, haemoglobin level changes, need for tocolytic therapy, oophorectomy rate)
cohort: A sample of 50 pregnant women in their first and second trimesters who required emergency ovarian operations and underwent laparoscopy.
finding: Laparoscopic surgery for emergency ovarian cysts during pregnancy can be performed safely and effortlessly with no maternal or neonatal complications, resulting in births after 38.3 weeks gestation.
gest_age: Participants were included in their first and second trimesters for surgery, with an average gestational age at surgery of 18.4 weeks, and all women gave birth after 38.3 weeks of gestation.
